description: The SawStop PCS is a 10-inch cabinet table saw with a cast-iron top. In the shop it is used to rip and crosscut solid wood and sheet goods, and to cut dados and bevels. Its safety system senses when skin touches the spinning blade. It then stops the blade in under 5 milliseconds and drops it below the table. A riving knife, a blade guard and a 4-inch dust port help keep cuts safe and clean.

specs.label: Rip capacity, right of blade
specs.value: 30 in, 36 in or 52 in, depending on fence fitted

specs.label: Motor
specs.value: 1.75 HP, 120 V, 14 A; or 3 HP, 230 V single-phase, 13 A (NEMA 6-15P plug)

specs.label: Dado capacity
specs.value: 8 in diameter, max 29/32 in wide (needs dado brake cartridge and insert)

specs.label: Blade stop time on skin contact

materials: MDF and other wood-based sheet goods
ppeRequired: no gloves, loose clothing or jewelry; tie back long hair
useRestrictions: Only trained users may run it, and only on wood and wood-based materials (no metal and no sanding or cutoff discs), with the riving knife or guard fitted; bypass mode and blade, dado or brake-cartridge changes are for shop staff only.
